Container.Name: Lineup
Container.Overview: Lineup provides a web dashboard for HDHomeRun discovery and proxying, live TV streaming, scheduled EPG collection, and XMLTV output for media servers such as Jellyfin and Plex. IMPORTANT FOR 2.0 UPGRADES: the persistent container path changed from /config to /appdata. Edit the existing Appdata mapping so that /appdata points to the same host directory previously mapped to /config before starting Lineup 2.0.
Container.Changes:
### 2026-09-17 - Updated the template for Lineup 2.0.0. - BREAKING: The persistent container path changed from /config to /appdata. Existing users must map /appdata to their existing Lineup appdata host directory before starting 2.0. - Added the HDHomeRun discovery/proxy and SSDP UDP port mappings.
### 2026-02-25 - Initial release

Config.Name: Web Interface (HTTP)
Config.Description: Host port mapped to Lineup's HTTP listener on TCP port 8080.

Config.Name: Web Interface (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Optional host port mapped to Lineup's HTTPS listener on TCP port 8443. HTTPS must be configured in Lineup.

Config.Name: HDHomeRun Discovery / Proxy
Config.Description: Optional UDP port used for HDHomeRun discovery and proxy traffic.

Config.Name: SSDP Discovery
Config.Description: Optional UDP port used for SSDP discovery traffic.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Lineup settings, database, and other application-owned state. For a 2.0 upgrade, keep your existing host path but change its container path from /config to /appdata.

Config.Name: XMLTV Output
Config.Description: Host path where Lineup stores generated XMLTV output.

Config.Name: Variable: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for the running container

Config.Name: Variable: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the running container
